note: The board draws the launcher as issue 21 proposes it, not as it is today, and pins each issue to the control that has to exist for that design to be true. A pin whose anchor is not in the mockup fails the build, so the target and the issue list cannot drift apart silently.

issues.title: Redesign the launcher UI
issues.pin: This panel is the target. Today the same controls are one flat column with no grouping and no first step.

issues.title: Shared lobby URL with port claiming
issues.pin: The room code is the lobby, top right, and clicking it copies the link. Signalling, claims and the data channel all measured working. Last gap: a browser on a second network.

issues.title: Lobby replaces the mode list
issues.pin: One persistent room per URL. A visitor is in it on arrival and gets a port assigned, rather than picking a mode to enter.

issues.title: Drop-in join
issues.pin: Taking a free port has to reach a match already running. The lobby depends on this, so it is not optional any more.

issues.title: Spectators and the port queue
issues.pin: Past four players everybody watches and queues. The next in line takes the first port that frees.

issues.title: TURN relay for symmetric NAT
issues.pin: The fallback this control names. Blocked: this network is cone, so it cannot produce the failing case.

issues.title: Modes become save states
issues.pin: Versus and Training stop being places to go. They load into the lobby that already exists, so nobody changes rooms.

issues.title: Verify the port runs on iOS Safari
issues.pin: The disc loads and boots. Measured working on iOS Safari.

issues.title: Disable Start while the disc loads
issues.pin: Nothing stops a press during the autoload today, and an early press starts the engine with no disc.

issues.title: Touch input layer
issues.pin: The shared state object every touch control writes to. One per port.

issues.title: Gamepad API for Bluetooth pads
issues.pin: A real pad claims a port like any other controller.

issues.title: Mobile CSS: pre-Start controls reachable
issues.pin: A test now fails if this bar moves out of thumb reach on a phone.

issues.title: Settings into tabs
issues.pin: 96 MELEE_* flags exist and the page showed 7 in one column. Tabs use the width and keep the list short.

issues.title: 20XX as a select-all
issues.pin: env_flag_or_20xx turns a sub-flag on when 20XX is on or when it is set alone, so the parent checkbox is what the code already does.

issues.title: Port the native launcher settings
issues.pin: UCF, aspect, HUD, textures, camera, stadium, volumes and the netplay name all exist in src/pc/launcher.cpp and on no web control.

issues.title: Training scenarios from a URL
issues.pin: Training is a state loaded into the lobby. Its tools run outside the player ports, so a scenario needs no seat.

issues.title: On-screen control layout
issues.pin: Where the pad layout is chosen. Needs a device in hand: no code decides where a thumb reaches.

issues.title: Accessibility defaults for touch
issues.pin: Tap-jump off, deadzone, curve, C-stick. Defaults chosen; the issue text still argues with itself. Wording only.

issues.title: Mobile layout: full-viewport canvas
issues.pin: On a phone this whole panel folds behind the menu button. Code complete, waits on one iPhone screenshot.

issues.title: Optimize the browser build
issues.pin: This control exists because of this issue: 18 fps on iOS against an -O1 build. Lowering the scale says whether pixels are the limit.

issues.title: Browser QoL: resume, pause, settings
issues.pin: Pause-on-blur landed. Resume after refresh and pause on crash did not. Parked.

issues.title: GC adapter called two missing C functions
issues.pin: Two calls into functions that were never defined. Removed.

issues.title: _malloc survived only by accident
issues.pin: Not in EXPORTED_FUNCTIONS. It worked until something else changed.

issues.title: launcher-close-repeat loses the GPU device
issues.pin: Apply reloads the page. Doing that repeatedly under the test harness destroys the GPU device on pass 1, so pass 2 finds none.

issues.title: Allow a CPU adapter behind a switch
issues.pin: A flag with no control, because it is for the test harness. aurora refuses a CPU adapter, so no browser check can boot the game.

issues.title: Headless runs can draw on the desktop
issues.pin: Fixed in melee-pc: the display variables are removed inside cage. melee-web still needs the same line.
